Put this on your Home Screen

Tap the Share button (square with an arrow) in Safari, then Add to Home Screen. After that, always open it from the new icon.

Records are kept separately for the Safari tab and the Home Screen icon, so don't enter burrows in Safari first.

How tortoises are counted

Each active burrow counts as one tortoise. Burrows closer together than the distance below are counted as one tortoise using more than one burrow.

40 ft

Phone GPS can be off by 10 to 15 ft, so very small distances can split one tortoise's burrows or merge two tortoises.

Use GPS location?

Gopher Tortoise Tracker can use your iPhone's GPS while the app is open to:

  • 📍Record exactly where each burrow is
  • 🧭Guide you back to a burrow with Find it
  • ◎Show how far every burrow is from you on the Burrow map

Your location is only used while the app is open, and it's stored only with your burrow records. You can change this anytime in Settings on the home page.
